evidence.source: REM-59 gate locked the panel partial-fetch / stale / fail-closed contract. The side-channel (section) fetch failure decision is now a single pure testable applySectionFailureP(): it PRESERVES any existing healthy sections and only marks the failure, falls back to the normal missing behavior on first load (no sections yet), and treats malformed/null sections input as an empty first load with no leak; sectionFetchState.lastError now holds ONLY a stable code (network/unauthorized/forbidden/not_found/rate_limited/conflict) instead of the prior String(err.message), so a raw network error, token or personal detail never enters panel state. Reminder system status is distinguished by emptyStateReasonP as unavailable/stale/error/pending/ok across three deterministic and disjoint kinds (unused/pending/error); while sectionFetchState.ok=false it never claims Hazir/success. fail() writes only the #app error screen and does NOT mutate the observer draft, token or selected UI state (verified with a brace-matching extractor); fail() and syncRibbonHTMLP carry no token sentinels. Recovery: a later successful poll clears sectionFetchState={ok:true,lastError:null,failedAt:null} (existing loop behavior).
